name: codex-windows-rescue
description: Safely diagnose and recover Codex on Windows, including API-to-ChatGPT migration, proxy failures, plugin problems, Chrome Native Host checks, and session restoration.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Windows Codex diagnosis and recovery
interface.longDescription: Diagnose Windows Codex layer by layer, migrate safely from API or cc-switch setups to ChatGPT sign-in, repair approved user-side issues one step at a time, inspect Chrome Native Messaging, generate redacted support reports for installer failures, and restore only session history from backups.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose my Windows Codex problem without changing anything first.
Help me migrate from API or cc-switch to ChatGPT sign-in safely.
Check why Codex Chrome control cannot connect.
Generate a redacted support report for my Chrome Native Host failure without changing anything.
